shared_elements: curved spiral horn rendered as a coil
carved relief figures on a rock surface
justification: Both surfaces depict a horned quadruped in profile with a prominently coiled/spiral horn, which is the single most specific correspondence. However, A is a densely populated naturalistic procession scene with human figures leading rams, decorative rosette borders and stylized fleece texture, while B is an isolated, heavily schematic outline animal with a large plain body and no accompanying figures, ornament or narrative context.
